procedure_name: UE Initiates Registration Procedure (Mobility and Periodic Update)
description: UE initiates the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update as defined in 3GPP specifications.

properties.description: UE determines the reason for initiating registration based on conditions a) through zp), zm1), zn), and zq).
UE sends a REGISTRATION REQUEST message to the AMF.
UE sets the 5GS registration type IE based on the registration reason.
If UE supports S1 mode, E-UTRA not disabled, and registration for specific reasons, set S1 mode bit in 5GMM capability IE and include S1 UE network capability IE.
UE sets capability bits in the 5GMM capability IE to indicate supported features.

parameters: restriction on the use of enhanced coverage
sending of REGISTRATION COMPLETE message for acknowledging the reception of Negotiated PEIPS assistance inforation IE
multiple user-plane resources in NB-N1 mode
the N1 NAS signalling connection release
the paging indication for voice services
Reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change (RANtiming)
S-NSSAI time validity information and S-NSSAI location validity information

properties.description: If single-registration mode and inter-system change from S1 to N1, may include Payload container IE set to 'UE policy container' and UE STATE INDICATION message.
If UE needs to request/change SMS over NAS, set SMS requested bit in the 5GS update type IE.
Start timer T3510 and stops timer T3502 and T3511 if those timers are running.
Include last visited registered TAI if available.
Include 5GS mobile identity IE with 5G-GUTI, 5G-GUTI mapped from 4G-GUTI, or SUCI. May also include NID or additional GUTI IE.
If supports and requests MICO mode, includes MICO indication IE, T3324 IE, and optionally Requested T3512 value IE.
If needs to use/change DRX parameters, include Requested DRX parameters IE.
If supports eDRX and requests its use, include Requested extended DRX parameters IE.
If needs to request LADN information, include LADN indication IE.
May include Uplink data status IE to indicate PDU sessions with pending user data.
When initiated in 5GMM-IDLE mode, may include PDU session status IE. If paging received with non-3GPP access type, include Allowed PDU session status IE.
If single-registration mode and inter-system change from S1 to N1, include UE status IE with EMM registration status set to 'UE is in EMM-REGISTERED state'.
If single-registration mode, inter-system change from S1 to N1 and initiated in 5GMM-IDLE mode, shall/may include a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message in the EPS NAS message container IE.
Include Requested NSSAI IE or Requested mapped NSSAI IE containing S-NSSAI(s) to which it intends to register.

For case zm1, if network indicated support for the unavailability period in the last registration procedure, the UE shall include the Unavailability information IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
The UE sets the Follow-on request indicator to Follow-on request pending if applicable.
For case n, the UE shall include the 5GS update type IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message with the NG-RAN-RCU bit set to UE radio capability update needed.
For case zf, the UE shall include the service-level device ID in the Service-level-AA container IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and set the value to the CAA-level UAV ID.
The UE shall send the REGISTRATION REQUEST message including the NAS message container IE as described in subclause 4.4.6.

For case zm1, if the network indicated support for the unavailability period in the last registration procedure, the UE shall include the Unavailability information IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

If the network supports the N1 NAS signalling connection release, and the MUSIM UE requests the network to release the NAS signalling connection, the UE shall set Request type to NAS signalling connection release in the UE request type IE, set the Follow-on request indicator to No follow-on request pending and, if the network supports the paging restriction, may set the paging restriction preference in the Paging restriction IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
Based on the triggering condition, the UE decides to send the REGISTRATION REQUEST.
Before sending, the UE needs to set the registration type.
Conditionally handle S1 mode support.
Set capability bits in the 5GMM capability IE.
Conditionally include the UE policy container.
Conditionally handle SMS over NAS.
Start the necessary timers after sending the request.
Optionally Include the last visited registered TAI.

Conditionally include the Update Type IE.
Conditionally include Service level AA container IE.

All conditions and optional fields configured, send message. The message flows back to the step responsible for sending the REGISTRATION REQUEST after all conditional elements have been evaluated.
